rounds.text: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality Ltd trades at an astronomical P/E of 236x based on filed statements [E1], which balloons further to 480x against a sector benchmark of just 26.58x according to key ratios data [E6]. This excessive valuation is completely disconnected from the fundamental operational collapse of the business, highlighted by a trailing twelve months profit growth of -93% [E20] and a stark negative operating margin of -65% in March 2026, marking an 81 percentage point deterioration over three years [E29]. The structural decay is deeply entrenched across all medium-term horizons, with compounded profit growth plunging by -10% over five years [E18] and -60% over three years [E19], alongside a poor sales growth of -39.0% over the past five years [E61]. Furthermore, return on assets is practically nonexistent at 0.06% compared to a sector benchmark of 1.54% [E8], and the company offers a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4] while sitting near the absolute bottom of its 52-week range at just 3% [E5]. Conceded: the price-to-book ratio sits at 0.31x on filed statements [E2] and 1.14x against sector benchmarks [E7], and quarterly sales showed dramatic year-over-year expansion [E67] driving a near-term margin recovery [E30] alongside historical 10-year profit growth of 18% [E17].

Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E18], [E19], [E20], [E29], [E61], [E8], [E4], and [E5]. Despite those multi-year headwinds, the stock trades at a deeply discounted price-to-book ratio of 0.31x on filed statements, backed by a book value of ₹ 146 against a share price of just ₹ 44.6 [E2], and aligns closely with sector median standards at 1.14x [E7]. Far from being structurally moribund, the business demonstrates tremendous cyclical elasticity with a massive 1224% year-over-year sales surge [E67] and strong sales growth indicators [E68]. This top-line explosion has directly ignited a dramatic operational turnaround, generating a massive 1536 percentage point quarterly margin recovery to -29% in March 2026 compared to the catastrophic -1565% recorded in the year-ago quarter [E30], accompanied by robust annual profit growth exceeding 20% YoY [E70]. Furthermore, long-term investors have a proven historical precedent of wealth creation, evidenced by an 18% compounded profit growth rate over a 10-year horizon [E17].

Conceded: [E67], [E68], [E70], and [E17]. The bull's narrative of a dramatic cyclical turnaround is completely undermined by the broader operational trajectory, where trailing twelve-month profit growth collapsed by -93% [E20] alongside a multi-year compounding decline of -60% over 3 years [E19] and -10% over 5 years [E18]. Pointing to a quarterly operating margin of -29% in March 2026 [E30] as a sign of health ignores the structural reality that operating margins sit at an abysmal -65% against a positive 16% three years prior [E29]. The appeal to a low price-to-book ratio of 0.31x [E2] is a classic value trap masking severe fundamental deterioration, evidenced by a return on assets of just 0.06% compared to the sector benchmark of 1.54% [E8]. Finally, the staggering P/E ratios of 236x [E1] and 480x [E6] prove that the market prices in zero margin of safety, while a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] offers investors no cash return while they wait out a stock languishing at the bottom 3% of its 52-week range [E5].
